decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing high-speed splash control and the permitted mitigation options.

The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures the approved speed range, operating modes, and prohibition on continuous maximum-speed operation; smooth high-speed output remains a mixing-quality constraint.
Possible whisk-position adjustment is only a conditional splash-control measure and does not change the selected whisk design or material.
The client merely permits bowl-depth adjustment if needed; no new depth or capacity is selected, so the existing bowl geometry remains unchanged.
The source concerns behavior during mixing at higher motor speeds and does not change dispensing flow or beverage preservation requirements.
The source does not alter the solenoid actuation mechanism or button-controlled dispensing behavior.
The high-speed mixing-quality decision does not change any food-contact material selection.
Controlling splashing and mixing aggressiveness does not modify the existing requirement for the bowl seal to prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The source does not change the spout-cleaning or liquid-path cleanability requirement.
Approval of the higher adjustable motor speed does not alter the standard 120V wall-power requirement.
The source sets operating behavior but does not change the requested wiring-plan deliverable or its detail level.
The source does not affect whether the spout components are removable for cleaning.
